mapper.insert: INSERT INTO picture_stats (picture_id, view_count, like_count, collect_count, download_count, share_count, impression_count, click_count, ctr, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{stats.pictureId}, COALESCE(#{stats.viewCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.likeCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.collectCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.downloadCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.shareCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.clickCount}, 0), CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(#{stats.clickCount}, 0)::numeric / COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0)::numeric ELSE 0.000000 END, statement_timestamp(), statement_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (picture_id) DO UPDATE SET view_count = picture_stats.view_count + EXCLUDED.view_count, like_count = picture_stats.like_count + EXCLUDED.like_count, collect_count = picture_stats.collect_count + EXCLUDED.collect_count, download_count = picture_stats.download_count + EXCLUDED.download_count, share_count = picture_stats.share_count + EXCLUDED.share_count, impression_count = picture_stats.impression_count + EXCLUDED.impression_count, click_count = picture_stats.click_count + EXCLUDED.click_count, -- PostgreSQL 的 SET 右侧全部看到旧行；ctr 必须显式用「旧值 + EXCLUDED」重算， -- 不能像 MySQL 那样依赖从左到右的赋值顺序。 ctr = CASE WHEN picture_stats.impression_count + EXCLUDED.impression_count > 0 THEN (picture_stats.click_count + EXCLUDED.click_count)::numeric / (picture_stats.impression_count + EXCLUDED.impression_count) ELSE 0.000000 END, update_time = statement_timestamp()
